authorization.scope: derive and package AC only; AR, manuscript migration, tag, merge and push remain unauthorized

common_domain.typing_note: y_bar is the A_M domain primitive; A_U is uniform in it. The A_U proposal y_H is not this primitive.

common_fiber.endpoints: eta=(*,nu), so nu_off=nu and rho is quotiented out
common_fiber.diagonal_requirement: A_M and A_U use the same d and the same eta

source_binder_sets.majority: B_M(d,eta), the complete frozen A_M binders in the fixed fiber; it may be empty at a fixed rho
source_binder_sets.unanimity: B_U(d,eta), the complete frozen A_U binders in the fixed fiber
source_binder_sets.atomicity: every strategy, belief, continuation, outcome and payoff coordinate is imported from one complete source binder; coordinate splicing is forbidden

primary_exact_relation.no_cross_world_restriction: proposals, named coalitions, supports, continuation selections and random realizations need not coincide; the model supplies no cross-world correlation device

declared_economic_operation.payoff_date: A in both sources and in AC

factorization_gate.same_fiber_constancy: if both source economic summaries are separately fixed in the same fiber, all coordinates of the declared economic operation are fixed
factorization_gate.setwise_lifting: the summary image is obtained from pairs of complete summary preimages; no type coordinate, posterior law or outcome is recombined across preimages
factorization_gate.excluded_operations: named supports, public posterior maps pointwise, message coincidence, named identities, type-plan relations and raw off-path functions

comparison_correspondence.existence: J_AC^bind(d,eta) is nonempty iff both B_M(d,eta) and B_U(d,eta) are nonempty
comparison_correspondence.none_rule: an empty comparison has status none and no numeric sentinel
comparison_correspondence.vector_contrast_set: D_01=V_U^01-V_M^01 using complete coupled type vectors, never products of type marginals
comparison_correspondence.ex_ante_contrast_image: D_E={(1-nu)*x_0+nu*x_1:(x_0,x_1) in D_01}; it is generally not the independently recombined Minkowski sum (1-nu)D_0+nu D_1
comparison_correspondence.scalar_sets: D_r={delta_r:r in {0,1,E}} and S_r={sign(x):x in D_r}
comparison_correspondence.envelopes: inf D_r=inf U_r-sup M_r and sup D_r=sup U_r-inf M_r, only after the exact set
comparison_correspondence.selection_note: in the high-prior rho=0 cell, U payoffs range over a nondegenerate interval; values are selection-dependent even when a sign is robust

selection_free_certificate.strict_condition: in a nonempty common fiber, beta*o_1<c/m implies V_M^theta-V_U^theta>=g_T5=beta*(c/m-beta*o_1)>0 and delta_E<=-g_T5 in every comparable pair
selection_free_certificate.low_cell_certificate: in a nonempty low-prior interior cell with nu_off=0 and Delta_U>=0, beta*o_0<c/m implies V_M^theta-V_U^theta>=g_0=beta*(c/m-beta*o_0)>0 for both types and ex ante
selection_free_certificate.nu_zero_certificate: at nu=0, beta*o_0<c/m implies the ex-ante margin V_M^E-V_U^E>=g_0>0; it does not by itself claim high-type counterfactual dominance
selection_free_certificate.parity: c/m=1/2 for odd N and (N-2)/(2*(N-1)) for even N
selection_free_certificate.scope: T5 is sufficient, not necessary; the low-cell certificate is local and the nu=0 statement is ex ante

outcome_scope.object: ordered pairs of anonymous type-conditioned realized-record laws
outcome_scope.coupling_qualification: mathematical couplings can be imposed, but no coupling is induced, selected or identified by the game form or AC

review_status: two independent formal reviews of one hash-pinned candidate are pending
